source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Board B of the Singles Event Companion is for Disruption against Reconnaissance. The Disruption player plays Smoke and Mirrors and the Reconnaissance player plays Surveil the Foe. Its deployment is Dawn Of War: the app links the layout to it and the printed zones match it. Neither disposition fixes the Attacker or Defender role; a roll-off settles that. Every zone, territory, objective and terrain position comes only from the official board image, and this entry states no measurements. Its lettered terrain pieces refer to the parts of the Battlefields: Armageddon kit.
